title: European privacy group challenges Scale AI's contractor monitoring
dek: Five complaints target Outlier's alleged trackers, biometric verification and workers' data-access rights.
evidence: Allegations in regulatory complaints; not adjudicated findings
takeaway: Training-data provenance includes worker privacy, consent, identity checks and data-retention practices—not just annotation quality.

sections.title: Context

bullets.lead: Human feedback has its own data risk
bullets.detail: Model trainers and annotators can be tracked and identity-verified while generating AI training labels; governance covers the people as well as the datasets.

paragraphs: Human feedback has its own data risk: Model trainers and annotators can be tracked and identity-verified while generating AI training labels; governance covers the people as well as the datasets.

sections.title: What's new

bullets.detail: Privacy group noyb filed complaints about Scale AI's Outlier contractor platform in Austria, France, Italy and the Netherlands.
The filings question third-party trackers (reportedly up to 19), recurring facial-video/identity checks, and access to stored worker information.

paragraphs: Five GDPR complaints: Privacy group noyb filed complaints about Scale AI's Outlier contractor platform in Austria, France, Italy and the Netherlands.
Allegations: The filings question third-party trackers (reportedly up to 19), recurring facial-video/identity checks, and access to stored worker information.

sections.title: Evidence & limitations

bullets.detail: The reported conduct remains allegations in complaints, not findings of a data protection authority or court.
Whether specific processing had valid consent or another lawful basis, what data was retained and which third parties received it require independent examination.

paragraphs: Legal status: The reported conduct remains allegations in complaints, not findings of a data protection authority or court.
Key unknowns: Whether specific processing had valid consent or another lawful basis, what data was retained and which third parties received it require independent examination.

sections.title: Why it matters

bullets.detail: Auditing an AI data supply chain means inspecting contractor-identity flows, analytics SDKs, data subject requests and retention policy.
Separate identity verification from productivity analytics and annotation output; avoid unrestricted behavioral telemetry just because a labeling platform enables it.

paragraphs: Data provenance includes workforce practices: Auditing an AI data supply chain means inspecting contractor-identity flows, analytics SDKs, data subject requests and retention policy.
Minimize collection: Separate identity verification from productivity analytics and annotation output; avoid unrestricted behavioral telemetry just because a labeling platform enables it.
